analysis.summary: This is a honey peanut snack bar. It has peanuts as a main ingredient, so it is not safe for your peanut allergy. It also has honey, which conflicts with a vegan diet, and a tree nut cross-contact warning.

personalFlags.title: Contains peanuts
personalFlags.explanation: Peanuts and peanut butter are listed as ingredients, and the label states it contains peanuts. This matches your peanut allergy.

personalFlags.title: May contain tree nuts
personalFlags.explanation: The label says it may contain tree nuts and is made in a facility that also processes them. This is a cross-contact risk for your tree nut allergy.
personalFlags.evidence: May contain tree nuts, milk, wheat and sesame.

personalFlags.title: Honey is not vegan
personalFlags.explanation: Honey is made by bees and is an animal product. It conflicts with a vegan diet.

personalFlags.title: May contain milk
personalFlags.explanation: The label says it may contain milk through cross-contact. This could matter for a vegan diet. Check with the maker if this is important to you.
personalFlags.evidence: May contain tree nuts, milk, wheat and sesame.

personalFlags.title: Natural flavor source unclear
personalFlags.explanation: Natural flavor can come from plants or animals. Check with the maker to confirm it fits a vegan diet.

labelWarnings.text: May contain tree nuts, milk, wheat and sesame, and is made in a facility that also processes these allergens.
labelWarnings.evidence: Made in a facility that also processes these allergens.

analysis.disclaimer: This explains the label and is not medical advice. If you are unsure, ask a doctor or pharmacist.
